item.content:encoded: While this episode isn’t expanding the scope of the show by any means, it is making me consider my own life and looks better than I’ve come to expect while doing so!

item.title: Young Ladies Don't Play Fighting Games ‒ Episode 7
item.content:encoded: At this point, we got a small handful of rivalries building up, and I’m 100% here for it.

item.title: Draw This, Then Die! ‒ Episode 7
item.content:encoded: Even when the show tries to frame things in a cheerful way, it never shies away from being uncomfortably real about how daunting being a creator actually is.

item.title: Yen Press Reveals 9 New Licenses Including Übel Blatt II, The Gray Exorcist, Seal My Lips With a Kiss Manga

item.title: Ize Press Announces Whale Star, Solo Leveling Releases at Anime NYC
item.content:encoded: Company to release <cite>Solo Leveling Ragnarok</cite> novel in English; <i>Solo Leveling</i> comic, novel, audiobook in Spanish

item.title: Tomb Raider King ‒ Episode 7
item.content:encoded: In Jaeha we get a novel and practical character concept that fits within the setting’s power system, but the show finds a way to immediately squander that potential.

item.title: Chainsmoker Cat ‒ Episode 8
item.content:encoded: This is not a drill. <i>Chainsmoker Cat</i> has given us a mischievous little beatboxing catboy with sharp teeth and a messy bowl cut, and he positively radiates incestual subtext.

item.title: I Want to Love You Till Your Dying Day ‒ Episode 7
item.content:encoded: This episode really went out of its way to make me feel emotional about its climax and dammit…it worked.

item.title: Clevatess Season 2 ‒ Episode 7
item.content:encoded: More anime should have the guts to say, “We're sorry, but the princess is in another castle…because she is reigning over the most wicked fiends of Hell with a ruthless iron fist.”
